exceptions.reason: A server render runs in Node with no DOM. The two cases are in the test file that the Node project runs, with the same titles.

The part must tell an absent `keepMounted` from `keepMounted={false}`, because only the explicit `false` gets a warning when `hiddenUntilFound` is set. A Boolean prop that is absent is `false` in Vue, so the declared default is `undefined`. The part uses `false` for an absent prop, which is the default that Base UI documents.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `disabled` for its state and for `useButton`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the trigger, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
The part reads `id` to give it to the root for `aria-controls`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the panel, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
